features.name: Training in War and Song
features.desc: You gain proficiency with Light armor, one kind of Martial weapon, and the Performance skill.

features.name: Bladesong
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, for 1 minute: +AC (Int modifier), +10 feet of Speed, Advantage on Acrobatics checks, and a bonus to Concentration. A number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.desc: When you take the Attack action, you attack twice; you can replace one attack with casting a cantrip.

features.name: Song of Defense
features.desc: While your Bladesong is active, you can expend a spell slot to reduce damage you take by 5 × the slot's level.

features.name: Song of Victory
features.desc: While your Bladesong is active, you add your Int modifier to melee weapon damage.
